provenance: Authored in this repository for the file-grain collapse conformance vectors. It is not derived from, and contains no material from, any benchmark repository, any held-out task, or any measured project. Nothing outside this file feeds the fixture, so the whole input is auditable by reading one document.
shape: A four-file dependency chain (config <- store <- api <- Router) so a two-hop neighbourhood has a distinct answer at every hop; one test file, so tested_by and the test entity kind are exercised; one external import, so the pathless-target rule is exercised; one file nothing imports, so the empty-neighbourhood case is a real file rather than a missing one; one barrel that re-exports itself, which is what actually produces an `imports` edge from a file to itself, so the self-edge rule has a case rather than a sentence. src/service/Router.ts and src/service/api.ts differ only in case at the first character of the basename, which is the pair that sorts differently under UTF-16 code units than under locale collation.
